scope: bounded developer diagnostic on already consumed three resin recipes, not independent confirmation
hypothesis: Preserve the strongest same-six physical Student4 marginals exactly while testing whether frozen full-rank dependence improves joint predictive score
population: same15 dev runs, original three recipe groups; never read other35 numeric viscosities
marginal_scale: sqrt of saved physical Student shape diagonal, not predictive SD
marginal_metrics: exact inherited original Student nearest-target CRPS/coverage/quantiles; structural identity, not new material performance
primary_joint_comparison: each full-law joint NLL/dimension minus original full multivariate Student strong baseline, recipe macro; report all four, no post-hoc blend
scope_limit: target-subset consistent at fixed O; no claim that models reconstructed under changed O are conditionals of one global joint law
tail_policy: sign plus smaller tail; Student logcdf/logsf to ndtri_exp for density; normal lower-tail plus signed Student inverse for sampling; no probability clip
stop: no retuning K/theta/scale/correlations, no new copula search on these three recipes if joint benefit fails; all failures retained
physical_scale_summary: log-Student exponentiation has no finite viscosity arithmetic expectation; report medians/quantiles/samples only
